name: Putnam Plaza
summary: Putnam Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center located on U.S. Route 6 in Carmel Hamlet, New York, managed by Regency Centers. The center serves the suburban communities of Putnam County with convenient retail and service options along a major thoroughfare in the Hudson Valley.
demographics: Putnam Plaza serves the affluent suburban communities of Carmel Hamlet and the greater Putnam County area in New York's Hudson Valley. The trade area attracts middle to upper-middle income families and professionals, with household incomes typically above the national average. Primary shoppers include working parents aged 35-65 seeking convenient neighborhood retail and services, along with retirees who value accessible shopping close to residential areas. The center draws from a stable, educated population with strong purchasing power typical of Westchester and Putnam County communities.
description: Putnam Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center strategically located along U.S. Route 6 in Carmel Hamlet, New York, serving the retail needs of Putnam County's suburban communities. Owned and operated by Regency Centers, a preeminent national owner and developer of shopping centers, Putnam Plaza exemplifies the company's focus on developing thriving centers in suburban trade areas with compelling demographics. The center provides convenient access to everyday retail, dining, and service options for local residents in this picturesque Hudson Valley location. With its position along a major thoroughfare, Putnam Plaza offers excellent visibility and accessibility for both local shoppers and commuters traveling through the area. As part of Regency Centers' portfolio of quality neighborhood shopping destinations, the center benefits from professional management and a commitment to creating communities where people gather for their daily shopping needs.
